quizData.question: Using `<div>` for a navigation bar is equally semantic as using `<nav>`.
quizData.explanation: `<nav>` explicitly identifies navigation, aiding accessibility and SEO; `<div>` is generic.

slides.title: Forms & Validation Refresher 📝
slides.content:
# Collecting User Input

- Every input needs a `<label>` (explicit or implicit).
- Use appropriate `type` (`email`, `number`, `tel`, etc.) for built‑in validation.
- Add `required`, `minlength`, `pattern` for client‑side checks.
- Group related controls with `<fieldset>` and `<legend>`.
- Submit buttons: `<button type="submit">` or `<input type="submit">`.

Always validate on the server too – client‑side is for convenience.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Write HTML First

When starting a project, resist the urge to style immediately. Mark up all content semantically. Once the structure is solid, CSS becomes much easier.
